baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purposive li-, first-person plural dispatch verb, alayhim, and the material phrase hijaratan min tin.
baseline_models.mechanism: A commissioned outward motion places a hard payload onto a target, while its clay composition keeps earth and water conceptually inside the projectile rather than treating material as incidental.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release supply the payload's directed outward motion.
Material hardness supplies the compact striking body.
Mixed earth-and-water matter specifies what the hard payload is made from.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified destructive shower is sent upon a group.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a purpose-governed dispatch whose hard projectiles still carry the mixed, terrestrial character of clay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The tension between nursila, hijaratan, and alayhim.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is released is itself an instrument of prevention and enclosure: mobility on the sender's side becomes blocked movement and closed space on the recipient's side.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the mobile first half of the reversal.
Prohibition and enclosure supply the immobilizing effect at the destination.
Clay coating supplies an adherent, space-closing material image.

changed_reading.before: The stones are only moving objects that strike.
changed_reading.after: They are mobile interdictions: released across space in order to impose a terminal boundary upon those below.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three nouns and roots permit dispatch, message, prohibition, and clay seal to overlap.
baseline_models.mechanism: The payload can be provisionally modeled as embodied communication: a dispatched, clay-sealed prohibition whose physical execution and semantic delivery coincide.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies a communicative function to the sending.
Interdiction supplies the content enacted by the hard object.
A clay seal supplies the image of authenticated closure.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each stone is an executed message: dispatch, prohibition, and clay authentication compressed into one material act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agents are addressed as messengers, report that they were sent, and then state the purpose of sending the stones. Agency therefore propagates through nested dispatch: commissioner to envoys to payload to target.

activation_trace.role: The focus dispatch supplies the final operative link toward the targets.
Messenger identity supplies the delegated human-like carrier layer.
Being sent supplies the prior motion that authorizes the envoys' own sending.
A grave occurring matter supplies the scale of the commission being relayed.

structural_cues: The repeated r-s-l sequence runs from al-mursalun in 51:31 through ursilna in 51:32 to nursila in 51:33.
The li- clause makes the focus action the stated purpose of the envoys' prior dispatch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sent envoys who themselves send a payload; I supply the relay arrow and treat repeated r-s-l as delegated agency. A live alternative is that the repetitions merely restate one continuous mission without emphasizing nested transmission.

changed_reading.before: A single sender directly hurls stones at a target.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is the terminal link in a commissioned relay: authority sends envoys, envoys dispatch matter, and matter reaches the designated group.

context_deltas.mechanism: An honored guest scene first moves rich nourishment from host toward visitors, but the visitors do not consume it; their disclosed mission then moves hard, inedible earth toward another group. The focus delivery becomes an inverse return within the episode's material economy.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch supplies the visitors' counter-directional delivery.
Hard stone supplies the inedible object opposed to the offered food.
Mixed earth supplies the anti-nourishing material of the later delivery.
A guest inclining to lodge supplies the social frame of reciprocal provision.
Honor and generosity make the first material transfer a gift.
Richness and fatness supply the abundance of the offered nourishment.
Bringing near supplies the host-to-guest vector that the later dispatch reverses.
Eating supplies the expected uptake whose absence leaves the first gift suspended.

structural_cues: The food is brought near in 51:26-27, but the question about not eating marks failed uptake.
The same visitors disclose in 51:31-33 that their operative delivery is stones of clay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unconsumed generous offering followed by the guests' destructive delivery; I supply the counter-gift relation between those transfers. A live alternative is simple narrative contrast with no exchange mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The clay stones belong only to a detached punishment scene.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are the visitors' anti-banquet: hard earth sent outward after rich food offered inward remains uneaten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus seed of message, interdiction, and clay seal is activated by branches for a written instrument, judgment, culpability, sovereignty, visible marking, and imposed harm. The projectiles can thus be carried as individually authenticated executions of a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies the writ-like communicative vehicle.
Interdiction supplies the binding force of the sentence.
Clay sealing supplies material authentication.
The written-document branch supplies the surprising juridical carrier image.
Judgment supplies the adjudicative frame for execution.
Culpable offense supplies the ground on which the sentence attaches.
Sovereign ownership supplies the issuing authority.
A visible identifying mark supplies individualized authentication.
The secondary mapped sense of imposed harm makes the mark operational rather than decorative.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from the s-k-k act in 51:29 through the Wise Lord in 51:30 and the mission in 51:31-33 to marked objects with the Lord in 51:34.
The marked-stone continuation immediately supplies a designation beyond the focus ayah's bare material phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies document, judgment, offense, sovereign, seal, and mark branches; I supply the legal-execution arrow that binds them into authenticated sentence-tokens. The materially live alternative is simply preselected ammunition with no juridical document metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The stones are anonymous pieces of destructive matter.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as marked, clay-sealed sentence-tokens whose delivery simultaneously communicates and executes sovereign judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those defined by cutting culpability and exceeding a limit receive objects whose focus-root can prohibit and enclose; judgment's restraining branch makes the impact a reciprocal restoration of a violated boundary.

activation_trace.role: Release carries the corrective boundary toward its recipients.
Prohibition and enclosure supply the hard limit imposed by the payload.
Restraint directed toward correction supplies the governing function of the limit.
Cutting and severance supply a target condition of broken relation.
Exceeding a bound supplies the transgression that the stone-boundary answers.

structural_cues: The target is renamed from criminals in 51:32 to limit-exceeders in 51:34.
The focus places the stone material directly alayhim, turning the semantic limit into a spatially imposed one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excess, severance, judgmental restraint, and enclosing stone; I supply the reciprocal arrow in which crossed limits call forth a material limit. A live alternative is that these are parallel moral and physical descriptions without reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The stonefall is force applied to wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: It materializes boundary restoration: those who overrun limits are met by a dispatched limit that encloses and terminates their movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Marking is followed by outward extraction of the secure group and identification of a single household. The focus action is therefore read as selective closure upon the remainder, not undifferentiated saturation of the inhabited place.

activation_trace.role: Directed dispatch supplies the controllable delivery stage after sorting.
An enclosed place supplies the spatial field that is closed upon the remainder.
Recognizable assignment supplies targeting before impact.
Passage outward supplies the evacuation gate preceding closure.
Security and settled trust identify the group admitted through that gate.
Exception and exclusion narrow the protected set.
The household branch supplies the single social cell extracted from the larger place.

structural_cues: Marked stones in 51:34 precede extraction in 51:35 and the count of one household in 51:36.
The focus pronoun alayhim can now resolve to the post-extraction remainder rather than every inhabitant of the place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies marking, extraction, security, exception, and one household; I supply a targeting-gate mechanism in which evacuation defines the residual referent of alayhim. A live alternative is that rescue and bombardment are coordinated narratively but not by a technical sorting process.

changed_reading.before: Stones descend broadly upon a populated settlement.
changed_reading.after: They close selectively upon a residual target set constituted only after the secure household has been taken out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The episode opens as a report and ends with an intentionally remaining sign for those who anticipate punishment. Hard stone and clay seal make the focus event a medium that survives its impact and transmits warning forward.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies transmission beyond immediate impact.
Hard stone supplies a durable memory substrate.
Clay sealing supplies the impression-like preservation of the event.
A report renewed in telling supplies the episode's opening communicative state.
Leaving a trace supplies persistence after the agents and victims are gone.
A manifest sign supplies the readable status of what remains.
Anticipatory fear supplies the future audience's mode of reception.
Punitive pain supplies the warning-content carried by the remaining sign.

structural_cues: Hadith in 51:24 frames the episode as transmissible report before the focus action occurs.
51:37 explicitly converts what happened in the place into a left sign for a later audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies report, durable materials, an intentionally left trace, a sign, and a warning audience; I supply the arrow that treats the stone event as the archive's material inscription. A live alternative is that the sign is the ruined site or total event rather than the stones specifically.

changed_reading.before: The stones complete their function when they strike.
changed_reading.after: Their impact also writes forward: destructive matter becomes a durable archive that repeatedly delivers the warning after the original dispatch.

context_deltas.mechanism: The envoys first remove immediate fear from Abraham by opening a joyful future, then their mission produces a sign that instills anticipatory fear in later observers. The focus payload becomes an affective relay that transfers fear away from the spared host and toward the warning's audience.

activation_trace.role: Message-bearing dispatch supplies the carrier for affective reassignment.
Hard impact supplies the feared consequence communicated to later observers.
Expected harm and its verbal negation supply the fear removed from Abraham.
Joy-opening news supplies the positive replacement for Abraham's fear.
Expected harm supplies the enduring response installed in the later audience.
The visible sign supplies the interface through which later fear is activated.

structural_cues: The same visitors say not to fear in 51:28 before disclosing the punitive mission.
The pericope closes in 51:37 by naming fear as the disposition that makes the remaining sign legible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear removed, glad tidings, destructive dispatch, and fear reactivated by a sign; I supply the affect-transfer arrow. A live alternative is that the two fears have different objects and merely frame the episode without being transferred.

changed_reading.before: The stones only cause fear and pain in their immediate targets.
changed_reading.after: They participate in a controlled redistribution of fear: canceled for the host, realized upon the target, and preserved as caution in future observers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a branch under the repeated s-l-m forms names hard stones, while other s-l-m evidence supplies safety; it remains anchored in the focus's literal hard stone and the extraction of one Muslim household. Downstream prose must present this as a branch-level lexical echo that sharpens a sorting contrast, not as a claim that the greetings or Muslim label literally mean stones here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hijaratan is the hard-stone target of an s-l-m branch activated by the doubled salam and the surviving Muslim household.

activation_trace.role: Literal hard stone anchors the branch-level echo in the focus object.
The hard-stone branch creates a startling lexical bridge from the doubled greeting to hijaratan.
Safety supplies the opposite outcome assigned to the extracted household.
Movement outward supplies the operation separating safety from stone impact.

changed_reading.before: Peace language and stone language occupy unrelated parts of the episode.
changed_reading.after: At branch level, the mission bifurcates one s-l-m field: safety is extracted with one household while hard stone is dispatched upon the remainder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it links the focus clay's formative branch to a promised boy, old age, barrenness, and a secondary growth branch under r-b-b; it remains anchored in tin and its formation inventory. Downstream prose must qualify it as a juxtaposed material analogy, not as an assertion that the verse identifies human creation with these particular stones.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tin carries a formation or disposition branch immediately after the envoys announce generation where age and barrenness seemed to block it.

activation_trace.role: Clay as formed disposition supplies the generative side of the material analogy.
Hard stone supplies the terminally fixed side of the contrast.
Joy-bearing news supplies the announced reversal toward life.
Youth supplies the new generative outcome.
Advanced age supplies one apparent closure of generation.
Barrenness supplies the second apparent closure that the birth announcement crosses.
The secondary mapped growth branch supplies nurture and emergence under the Lord's saying.

changed_reading.before: Clay merely describes the geology of the projectiles.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clay stands at the episode's life-or-closure threshold: formation opens toward a boy in one commission and hardens into terminal consequence in the other.

strongest_changes: Repeated r-s-l turns the focus into the last link of a delegated dispatch chain.
Clay sealing, written-instrument, judgment, culpability, sovereign, and split marking branches make the stones readable as authenticated sentence-tokens.
Limit-exceeding activates hijr as a material boundary, while extraction and one-house exception make the impact selectively post-evacuation.
The opening report and closing left sign turn hard clay from expended ammunition into a durable warning archive.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact material phrase supported unusually coherent reversals: release becomes restraint, payload becomes message, and impact becomes archive. The context then supplied exact high-surprise activators, especially the clay seal with marked assignment, the s-k-k document branch, nested sending, the salām hard-stone echo, and the contrast between generative clay and terminal hardening.
remaining_uncertainties: The sealed-writ model may be a productive legal metaphor for targeted stones rather than a mechanism asserted by the syntax.
The enduring sign may be the ruined place or whole event rather than the stones themselves.
The hospitality counter-delivery, s-l-m hard-stone echo, and generation-versus-hardening model remain branch-distant and should stay explicitly exploratory.
